answer: A bond of 59% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in relic, and spiral reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 155 aliases, and each one needs its own funded inlet account. Repeating the trick 29 times costs 7 separate deposits and 32 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
